parole.testo: From a Caspian language, probably Mazanderani جفری (jaferi). Cognate with obsolete Transoxianan Persian ژافه (žâfa, “a kind of pungent herb”), dialectal زافه (zâfe, “a kind of Persian shallot”), and Sanskrit जवा (javā, “saffron, rose”). Borrowed from a Caspian language where غل (ğal), گل (gal, “mouse”) equalling Classical Persian گرزه (garza, “rat”) was compounded via optional genitive -ē with a cognate of the stem of Middle Persian [Book Pahlavi needed] (wʾcytn' /⁠vāzītan⁠/, “to carry away”), so literally “mouse-grabber”.

parole.significato: for, by reason of, for the sake of
